# Method provenance and code availability

<!-- Generated by scripts/check-method-catalog.py; edit method-catalog.json instead. -->

The catalog records method provenance, software availability, and bounded validation evidence. Passing its checker is not evidence of universal statistical validity, application validity, or scientific novelty.

## How to read the catalog

- **Paper-defined** means the mathematical quantity or estimator is taken directly from a cited primary source.
- **Paper-derived** means the implementation composes or adapts published components; the exact composition is not asserted to be a published estimator.
- **Project-defined** means a local diagnostic, workflow, API contract, adapter, or software facility.
- **Implementation origin** is `local-implementation` for code written in this repository, `binding` for a language wrapper, `external` for pinned validation-only code, and `not-implemented` for an explicit negative capability.
- For software references, the displayed year is the year of the pinned validation revision, not a claim about project inception.
- **`depends_on` semantics:** depends_on lists curated method-level dependencies whose estimand, implementation, or scientific status materially constrains the row; it is not an exhaustive source-level call graph. Stable rows may depend only on stable rows; experimental software can compose a research-only estimator only when the stricter scientific boundary is explicit in its constraints.
- **Rust entry-point semantics:** Rust entry points are curated public call sites for each scientific row, not an exhaustive API inventory. release-scope-1.0.json is authoritative for the complete exported-symbol set and its feature/stability boundary.
- **Python entry-point semantics:** Python entry points record callable, class, and policy-attribute availability. The pid_core_rs.experimental.migration surface is exhaustively inventoried in its software row; configurable wrappers may appear on multiple scientific rows, and that prefix denotes an experimental compatibility surface rather than the stability of the wrapped Rust family. cargo_features records pid-core gates; binding rows state the separate pid-python build feature in their constraints.
- **New in pid-rs** describes repository engineering and packaging only. Every row records `scientific_novelty_claim = none`.
- Validation levels are bounded evidence labels. Reference agreement, tests, and formal checks do not establish universal statistical or application validity.
- **Frozen semantic authority:** This authority is a deterministic canonical-JSON change detector over every complete method row, its resolved linked-reference records, and four reviewed typed facts. It forces an explicit checker-root re-adjudication after any catalog-byte, authority-schema, typed-fact, alias-inventory, or semantic-prose change. It is not natural-language understanding, literature interpretation, truth inference, independent review, or evidence that a claim is scientifically valid; a coordinated authority rebase can still encode a wrong claim and therefore requires human review.
- **Alias diagnostic boundary:** The versioned alias diagnostic recognizes only its closed curated spellings after the declared Unicode/confusable normalization. It is not NLP, transliteration, authorship resolution, or a complete vocabulary. Exact payload freezing, not alias coverage, rejects vocabulary-free or otherwise unrecognized prose drift.

- **`data_domain` semantics:** Scientific input-variable or record kind addressed by the row; a storage dtype or successful parse does not establish this domain.
- **`population_support` semantics:** Declared, induced, inherited, diagnostic-only, or unavailable population-support regime; this field is not inferred from samples and is not a consistency or calibration claim.
- **`conditioning` semantics:** External analysis-design, fitted-artifact, observation-model, or composition conditioning attached to the implemented row; this field does not inventory every conditional probability inside a defining formula.
- **`estimand_family` semantics:** Closed method-family identity for this row; shared names, dependencies, units, and bindings do not transfer estimands or theorems between families.

## Method details

These sections render every catalog field. Dependencies follow the curated semantics above and are not an exhaustive source call graph.

### `co-information.continuous-raw` — Raw continuous KSG co-information

Raw continuous co-information obtained by inclusion-exclusion over KSG mutual-information estimates.

- **Classification:** category `measure`; definition `paper-derived`; implementation `local-implementation`; status `research-only`; code availability `local`.
- **Cargo features:** `experimental-continuous`.
- **Rust entry points:** `pid_core::experimental::continuous::raw_scalars::co_information_pairwise`, `pid_core::experimental::continuous::raw_scalars::co_information_triplet`.
- **Python entry points:** `pid_core_rs.experimental.migration.compute_co_information`.
- **Source files:** `crates/pid-core/src/ci.rs`.
- **Source marker files:** `crates/pid-core/src/ci.rs`.
- **Release-scope families:** `pid-core.research.raw-co-information`.
- **Curated dependencies:** `mutual-information.ksg1-raw`.
- **Papers/reference code:** [Anthony J. Bell (2003)](https://www.rd.ntt/cs/team_project/icl/signal/ica2003/cdrom/data/0187.pdf) (`defining-paper`; co-information name, inclusion-exclusion definition, and sign convention); [William J. McGill (1954)](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF02289159) (`methodological-background`; historical multivariate interaction-information antecedent); [Alexander Kraskov et al. (2004)](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.69.066138) (`implementation-basis`; KSG mutual-information estimator)
- **External code pin:** —.
- **New in pid-rs:** Exposes raw KSG plug-in alternating sums for controlled research comparisons.
- **Scientific novelty claim:** `none`.
- **Typed semantic facts:** data domain `euclidean-continuous`; population support `regular-full-dimensional-continuous-required`; conditioning `inherits-composed-method-contracts`; estimand family `bell-co-information`.
- **Observed alias families (diagnostic revision 1):** `ehrlich-continuous-shared-exclusions`, `ksg-mutual-information`, `mgw-categorical-shared-exclusions`.
- **Reviewed semantic payload SHA-256:** `3d9f6140ad655e72f44f5f5c2909e3a409d035a81642e77bce19659fc4bfe1f6`.
- **Constraints:** Alternating sums inherit the assumptions and finite-sample errors of every component KSG estimate.<br>pid-rs uses Bell's co-information sign convention; literature using McGill-style interaction information may use the opposite sign.
- **Bounded validation:** `property-and-integration` — Deterministic identity and cross-path checks on finite fixtures. Where this surface emits or composes an eligible KSG, Ehrlich shared-exclusions, or PID term, its integer-harmonic dependency is checked by the revision-4 exact 6,920-tuple route and the schema-revision-2 frozen 8,198-row 80-digit Decimal corpus. A direct compiled Rust full-corpus test classifies the selected Neumaier-prefix/sorted-range association as 354 positive zeros, 0 negative zeros, and 7,844 nonzeros. On that corpus, a separately implemented Python reproduction has two distinct reference results: its maximum difference from binary64(stored Decimal prefix text) is 8 * f64::EPSILON nats with 40 ties, while a 160-digit directed enclosure of the exact harmonic rational proves a unique maximum at zero-based row 7,673 with upper bound below 9.761311 * f64::EPSILON nats. Both are below the reviewed finite-corpus ceiling of 32 * f64::EPSILON nats. Exact-rounded 80-digit references differ textually on 6,509 rows and numerically on 5,934 rows, yet all 8,198 pairs convert to the same binary64 value. The exact-enclosure route performs exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparisons on all 8,198 rows and exact Fraction containment on all 6,920 exhaustive rows; its scientific/custody suite kills 29/29 registered mutations and its separately counted exact-comparator firewall rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. The modular certificate classifies exact rational zeros only on the frozen corpus; its scientific/custody suite kills 28/28 registered mutations and its strict recursive exact JSON shape/type/value firewall separately rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. Its single composite-modulus mutation uses 1000001=101*9901, bypasses the 2-through-37 small-prime prefilter, and exercises the deterministic u32 Miller--Rabin witness loop without increasing the 28-mutation inventory. The revision-4 formal route kernel-checks 19 scoped Lean theorems and solver-checks four conditional Z3 obligations. Its repaired bounded exact-profile SMT-LIB parser and type checker validates captured proof snapshots and sends the derived positive and exact negative forms to Z3 over standard input; the self-test retains 12/12 semantic countermodels and separately rejects 52/52 firewall controls: 16 lexer/parser, 25 profile/type, and 11 custody/transport/result. Limitations: Agreement of component identities does not calibrate bias of the alternating sum. This validates only the eligible local integer-argument arithmetic dependency on the frozen corpus. The direct compiled partition is a bounded regression result, not validation of the complete estimator, arbitrary builds, or portable identity. The 8-epsilon rounded-reference comparator is not exact-rational error, an ULP claim, or a universal error theorem. The 160-digit enclosure and exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparison are finite-corpus computational results; the 1,278 stress rows retain Decimal directed-rounding semantics as a premise, and no implementation-refinement or universal-precision theorem follows. The runtime inequality x+y <= n+k is only a conditional source lemma under a finite positive max-product radius, an unambiguous unique kth shell, one common row set, exact strict-radius membership counts, and the inventoried count map; neither it nor the stronger balanced lower bound is promoted into the revision-4 theorem inventory. Lean and Z3 share the typed analytic digamma premise, human coefficient signs, index maps, and selected statements; neither formalizes Rust, binary64, or neighbor geometry. The SMT raw-byte and token-stream pins are correlated custody views of the same sources, not independent proofs or authenticity evidence. The bounded exact profile cannot establish theorem intent: a retained well-typed wrong-digamma statement still has the expected solver outcomes after deliberate dual-pin rebase and all 12 prior semantic mutants remain satisfiable, so this is a negative adequacy boundary. Z3 returns solver answers rather than independently kernel-checked proof objects. The selected modular primes share the elementary H_(p-1-t)=H_t mod p reflection structure; exhaustive certificate replay is the corpus authority, while the fields provide redundant fault diversity rather than CRT reconstruction or independent proofs. The one composite witness is path coverage, not a universal proof of the primality implementation; generator trial division and checker Miller--Rabin remain correlated arithmetic code under the same selected-modulus specification. The Python binary64 replay does not prove Rust/Python/Decimal refinement, neighbor counts, population support, estimator consistency, the surrounding composition, an Ehrlich or Makkeh--Gutknecht--Wibral functional, PID atoms, calibration, or application assumptions. Where this surface emits or composes an eligible KSG, Ehrlich shared-exclusions, or PID term, its integer-harmonic dependency is checked by the revision-4 exact 6,920-tuple route and the schema-revision-2 frozen 8,198-row 80-digit Decimal corpus. A direct compiled Rust full-corpus test classifies the selected Neumaier-prefix/sorted-range association as 354 positive zeros, 0 negative zeros, and 7,844 nonzeros. On that corpus, a separately implemented Python reproduction has two distinct reference results: its maximum difference from binary64(stored Decimal prefix text) is 8 * f64::EPSILON nats with 40 ties, while a 160-digit directed enclosure of the exact harmonic rational proves a unique maximum at zero-based row 7,673 with upper bound below 9.761311 * f64::EPSILON nats. Both are below the reviewed finite-corpus ceiling of 32 * f64::EPSILON nats. Exact-rounded 80-digit references differ textually on 6,509 rows and numerically on 5,934 rows, yet all 8,198 pairs convert to the same binary64 value. The exact-enclosure route performs exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparisons on all 8,198 rows and exact Fraction containment on all 6,920 exhaustive rows; its scientific/custody suite kills 29/29 registered mutations and its separately counted exact-comparator firewall rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. The modular certificate classifies exact rational zeros only on the frozen corpus; its scientific/custody suite kills 28/28 registered mutations and its strict recursive exact JSON shape/type/value firewall separately rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. Its single composite-modulus mutation uses 1000001=101*9901, bypasses the 2-through-37 small-prime prefilter, and exercises the deterministic u32 Miller--Rabin witness loop without increasing the 28-mutation inventory. The revision-4 formal route kernel-checks 19 scoped Lean theorems and solver-checks four conditional Z3 obligations. Its repaired bounded exact-profile SMT-LIB parser and type checker validates captured proof snapshots and sends the derived positive and exact negative forms to Z3 over standard input; the self-test retains 12/12 semantic countermodels and separately rejects 52/52 firewall controls: 16 lexer/parser, 25 profile/type, and 11 custody/transport/result. Limitations: Internal parity and invariance checks are not a consistency proof or calibration study. This validates only the eligible local integer-argument arithmetic dependency on the frozen corpus. The direct compiled partition is a bounded regression result, not validation of the complete estimator, arbitrary builds, or portable identity. The 8-epsilon rounded-reference comparator is not exact-rational error, an ULP claim, or a universal error theorem. The 160-digit enclosure and exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparison are finite-corpus computational results; the 1,278 stress rows retain Decimal directed-rounding semantics as a premise, and no implementation-refinement or universal-precision theorem follows. The runtime inequality x+y <= n+k is only a conditional source lemma under a finite positive max-product radius, an unambiguous unique kth shell, one common row set, exact strict-radius membership counts, and the inventoried count map; neither it nor the stronger balanced lower bound is promoted into the revision-4 theorem inventory. Lean and Z3 share the typed analytic digamma premise, human coefficient signs, index maps, and selected statements; neither formalizes Rust, binary64, or neighbor geometry. The SMT raw-byte and token-stream pins are correlated custody views of the same sources, not independent proofs or authenticity evidence. The bounded exact profile cannot establish theorem intent: a retained well-typed wrong-digamma statement still has the expected solver outcomes after deliberate dual-pin rebase and all 12 prior semantic mutants remain satisfiable, so this is a negative adequacy boundary. Z3 returns solver answers rather than independently kernel-checked proof objects. The selected modular primes share the elementary H_(p-1-t)=H_t mod p reflection structure; exhaustive certificate replay is the corpus authority, while the fields provide redundant fault diversity rather than CRT reconstruction or independent proofs. The one composite witness is path coverage, not a universal proof of the primality implementation; generator trial division and checker Miller--Rabin remain correlated arithmetic code under the same selected-modulus specification. The Python binary64 replay does not prove Rust/Python/Decimal refinement, neighbor counts, population support, estimator consistency, the surrounding composition, an Ehrlich or Makkeh--Gutknecht--Wibral functional, PID atoms, calibration, or application assumptions. None of this evidence transfers beyond local integer arithmetic to the complete KSG estimator, continuous shared exclusions, PID2 or PID3, MGW SxPID3, wrappers, diagnostics, or downstream applications; not every scalar exposed by a transitive surface changes. Same-repository digests, reviewed prose bytes, and no-write replay establish internal correspondence, not artifact authenticity or scientific truth. (2010)](https://arxiv.org/abs/1004.2515) (`implementation-basis`; categorical minimum-specific-information redundancy functional)

- **New in pid-rs:** Composes evaluation-row-derived exact-significand labels with the categorical Williams-Beer I_min implementation and exposes the limited Rust provenance wrapper; deprecated Python compatibility functions preserve only their historical flat result shape.
- **Scientific novelty claim:** `none`.
- **Typed semantic facts:** data domain `continuous-to-finite-categorical`; population support `empirical-finite-pmf`; conditioning `evaluation-sample-derived-transform`; estimand family `same-sample-quantized-williams-beer-imin`.

- **Constraints:** Each input column's minimum and maximum are computed on the same evaluated rows used to form the empirical PMF, then bins are selected with quantization.same-sample-exact-significand; no edge vector, held-out transform, or reusable fitted-transform artifact is produced.<br>The Rust result wrapper contains the categorical result plus a quantization-provenance component whose only field is num_bins. No edge vector is materialized, and that component retains no ranges, occupancies, source order, input or output hashes, training identity, or evaluation identity; into_categorical_result explicitly discards it.<br>Deprecated Python compute_discrete_pid2 and compute_discrete_pid3 return flat dictionaries and discard the Rust wrapper's num_bins-only provenance component, input identity, empirical-PMF metadata, and training/evaluation distinction.<br>Before calling the Rust wrapper, deprecated Python retains a conservative legacy O(columns times (num_bins+1)) preflight. It can reject large bin counts that the Rust exact-significand transform can represent; admitted Python calls use the Rust transform, but the accepted input domains are not identical.<br>The returned atoms use the Williams-Beer I_min redundancy functional. They are not categorical Makkeh-Gutknecht-Wibral shared-exclusions atoms, an Ehrlich continuous shared-exclusions estimate, or a fallback for failed KSG estimation; independent two-bit COPY has identical mutual-information coordinates but I_min redundancy ln(2) versus categorical shared-exclusions redundancy ln(4/3).<br>This evaluation-row-fitted adapter is distinct from pid.fitted-quantized-imin, whose reusable fitted quantizers retain edges, hashes, occupancies, and training/evaluation identities.<br>The two-source I_min result inherits the witnessed exact represented-binary64 synergy reduction; the three-source result retains the compensated Mobius path. This arithmetic distinction does not identify or merge PID measures.<br>The Rust two-source wrapper is exercised on the pinned source-swap witness. The deprecated Python wrapper retains bounded warning, shape, and rejection tests but has no separate exact-bit parity or portable-identity claim.
- **Bounded validation:** `property-and-integration` — Two- and three-source same-row range derivation, exact-significand label assignment, requested-bin propagation in Rust, direct/wrapper first-rejection resource parity, the outlier-appending relabeling witness, a two-source exact represented-synergy and source-swap wrapper comparison, Python warning/shape/exception compatibility, identical three-source I_min/MGW antichain-key sets that cannot identify the functional, and the exact independent-COPY counterexample separating I_min from categorical shared exclusions despite identical mutual-information coordinates. Limitations: The tests establish bounded wrapper propagation, deterministic sample dependence, warning text, categorical identities, one source-swap wrapper witness, and the Python legacy-preflight rejection boundary. They do not justify a bin count, establish held-out inference, remove empirical-PMF bias, prove convergence for changing same-sample transforms, make Python and Rust accepted domains identical, or map I_min to MGW or Ehrlich shared exclusions. The exhaustive binary-table census exercises the direct categorical route; it does not exhaust the wrapper's numeric input domain. - **External code pin:** —.
- **New in pid-rs:** Quarantines deterministic comparison baselines under an explicit heuristics namespace and labels their formulas.
- **Scientific novelty claim:** `none`.
- **Typed semantic facts:** data domain `euclidean-continuous`; population support `inherits-composed-method-contracts`; conditioning `inherits-composed-method-contracts`; estimand family `project-continuous-shared-exclusions-heuristic`.
- **Observed alias families (diagnostic revision 1):** `ehrlich-continuous-shared-exclusions`, `ksg-mutual-information`, `mgw-categorical-shared-exclusions`.
- **Reviewed semantic payload SHA-256:** `7a72d260510ddd8c451c905f3a19bcc8a947c73d8a9080ec07a48c79bd2f7229`.
- **Constraints:** Formula-labelled baselines do not estimate the Ehrlich et al. continuous shared-exclusions functional.<br>Configured Rust pid2_isx and pid2_isx_with_budget plus experimental Python compute_pid2 compose a heuristic redundancy with the revised represented-input-exact PID2 constructor; hierarchy and pair-screening propagation are documented by their own family rows. Standalone Rust heuristic redundancy functions and Python compute_redundancy remain scalar-only. Rust pid2_isx_report and pid2_isx_report_with_budget plus Python compute_pid2_report reject heuristic methods before PID2 report construction because complete reports require the cited Ehrlich construction. Exact final summation neither validates a heuristic redundancy nor turns it into the Ehrlich functional.
- **Bounded validation:** `unit-and-integration` — Local-min formula identity, source symmetry across all three baselines, finite smoke checks, and shared shell rejection. Where this surface emits or composes an eligible KSG, Ehrlich shared-exclusions, or PID term, its integer-harmonic dependency is checked by the revision-4 exact 6,920-tuple route and the schema-revision-2 frozen 8,198-row 80-digit Decimal corpus. A direct compiled Rust full-corpus test classifies the selected Neumaier-prefix/sorted-range association as 354 positive zeros, 0 negative zeros, and 7,844 nonzeros. On that corpus, a separately implemented Python reproduction has two distinct reference results: its maximum difference from binary64(stored Decimal prefix text) is 8 * f64::EPSILON nats with 40 ties, while a 160-digit directed enclosure of the exact harmonic rational proves a unique maximum at zero-based row 7,673 with upper bound below 9.761311 * f64::EPSILON nats. Both are below the reviewed finite-corpus ceiling of 32 * f64::EPSILON nats. Exact-rounded 80-digit references differ textually on 6,509 rows and numerically on 5,934 rows, yet all 8,198 pairs convert to the same binary64 value. The exact-enclosure route performs exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparisons on all 8,198 rows and exact Fraction containment on all 6,920 exhaustive rows; its scientific/custody suite kills 29/29 registered mutations and its separately counted exact-comparator firewall rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. The modular certificate classifies exact rational zeros only on the frozen corpus; its scientific/custody suite kills 28/28 registered mutations and its strict recursive exact JSON shape/type/value firewall separately rejects 2/2 controls in normal and optimized Python. Its single composite-modulus mutation uses 1000001=101*9901, bypasses the 2-through-37 small-prime prefilter, and exercises the deterministic u32 Miller--Rabin witness loop without increasing the 28-mutation inventory. The revision-4 formal route kernel-checks 19 scoped Lean theorems and solver-checks four conditional Z3 obligations. Its repaired bounded exact-profile SMT-LIB parser and type checker validates captured proof snapshots and sends the derived positive and exact negative forms to Z3 over standard input; the self-test retains 12/12 semantic countermodels and separately rejects 52/52 firewall controls: 16 lexer/parser, 25 profile/type, and 11 custody/transport/result. Limitations: Formula and determinism tests do not make the baselines estimators of the paper functional. This validates only the eligible local integer-argument arithmetic dependency on the frozen corpus. The direct compiled partition is a bounded regression result, not validation of the complete estimator, arbitrary builds, or portable identity. The 8-epsilon rounded-reference comparator is not exact-rational error, an ULP claim, or a universal error theorem. The 160-digit enclosure and exact Fraction(Decimal(...)) discrepancy comparison are finite-corpus computational results; the 1,278 stress rows retain Decimal directed-rounding semantics as a premise, and no implementation-refinement or universal-precision theorem follows. The runtime inequality x+y <= n+k is only a conditional source lemma under a finite positive max-product radius, an unambiguous unique kth shell, one common row set, exact strict-radius membership counts, and the inventoried count map; neither it nor the stronger balanced lower bound is promoted into the revision-4 theorem inventory. Lean and Z3 share the typed analytic digamma premise, human coefficient signs, index maps, and selected statements; neither formalizes Rust, binary64, or neighbor geometry. The SMT raw-byte and token-stream pins are correlated custody views of the same sources, not independent proofs or authenticity evidence. The bounded exact profile cannot establish theorem intent: a retained well-typed wrong-digamma statement still has the expected solver outcomes after deliberate dual-pin rebase and all 12 prior semantic mutants remain satisfiable, so this is a negative adequacy boundary. Z3 returns solver answers rather than independently kernel-checked proof objects. The selected modular primes share the elementary H_(p-1-t)=H_t mod p reflection structure; exhaustive certificate replay is the corpus authority, while the fields provide redundant fault diversity rather than CRT reconstruction or independent proofs. The one composite witness is path coverage, not a universal proof of the primality implementation; generator trial division and checker Miller--Rabin remain correlated arithmetic code under the same selected-modulus specification. The Python binary64 replay does not prove Rust/Python/Decimal refinement, neighbor counts, population support, estimator consistency, the surrounding composition, an Ehrlich or Makkeh--Gutknecht--Wibral functional, PID atoms, calibration, or application assumptions. None of this evidence transfers beyond local integer arithmetic to the complete KSG estimator, continuous shared exclusions, PID2 or PID3, MGW SxPID3, wrappers, diagnostics, or downstream applications; not every scalar exposed by a transitive surface changes. Same-repository digests, reviewed prose bytes, and no-write replay establish internal correspondence, not artifact authenticity or scientific truth. (1998)](https://doi.org/10.1109/18.720541) (`implementation-basis`; uniform quantization background)

- **Scientific novelty claim:** `none`.
- **Typed semantic facts:** data domain `continuous-to-finite-categorical`; population support `fixed-transform-induced-finite-pmf`; conditioning `fixed-fitted-artifact`; estimand family `fitted-quantized-mgw-shared-exclusions`.

- **Constraints:** The result is PID of declared quantized variables; fitted edges and held-out policies are part of the estimand.<br>The convergence corollary requires a training artifact that is independent of the raw evaluation sequence, and a frozen map that is measurable with respect to the training sigma-field and raw input, returns a valid finite output with conditional probability one, and is applied to conditionally i.i.d. evaluation rows; same-row fitting, transform changes, dependence, and drift are outside its scope.
- **Bounded validation:** `property-and-integration` — Two-, three-, and four-source fit/evaluation separation, overflow-safe fixed-edge reuse, nominal/map-reachable/observed diagnostics, ordered provenance, numerical equivalence to categorical results, actual-payload byte and operation preflight for fixed-array and variable-source report containers, and one bounded quantizer-to-SxPID comparison. Limitations: Transform and composition tests do not establish equivalence to continuous PID or an optimal binning rule. Binary64-map reachability is not population support or positive probability. The companion Rust composition check is bounded software evidence; the Decimal fixture does not contain quantizer inputs. It is not a population theorem or a global binary64 bound. (2021)](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevE.103.032149) (`implementation-basis`; categorical pointwise shared-exclusions functional)
- **External code pin:** —.
- **New in pid-rs:** Composes evaluation-row-derived exact-significand labels with the categorical Makkeh-Gutknecht-Wibral implementation and exposes the limited Rust provenance wrapper; deprecated Python compatibility functions preserve only their historical flat result shape.
- **Scientific novelty claim:** `none`.
- **Typed semantic facts:** data domain `continuous-to-finite-categorical`; population support `empirical-finite-pmf`; conditioning `evaluation-sample-derived-transform`; estimand family `same-sample-quantized-mgw-shared-exclusions`.

- **Constraints:** Each source and target column's minimum and maximum are computed on the same evaluated rows used to form the empirical PMF, then bins are selected with quantization.same-sample-exact-significand; no edge vector, held-out transform, or reusable fitted-transform artifact is produced.<br>The Rust wrapper contains a typed categorical SxPID result plus a quantization-provenance component whose only field is num_bins. No edge vector is materialized, and that component retains no ranges, occupancies, source order, input or output hashes, training identity, or evaluation identity; into_categorical_result can explicitly discard it.<br>Deprecated Python compute_quantized_sxpid2, compute_quantized_sxpid3, and compute_quantized_sxpid_n call the same Rust adapters but return flat dictionaries, discarding the quantization-provenance component's num_bins field together with input/PMF metadata and typed atom interpretation.<br>Before calling the Rust wrapper, deprecated Python retains a conservative legacy O(columns times (num_bins+1)) preflight. It can reject large bin counts that the Rust exact-significand transform can represent; admitted Python calls use the Rust transform, but the accepted input domains are not identical.<br>The returned atoms use the categorical Makkeh-Gutknecht-Wibral shared-exclusions functional. They are not Williams-Beer I_min atoms, an Ehrlich continuous shared-exclusions estimate, or a fallback for failed KSG estimation; independent two-bit COPY has identical mutual-information coordinates but categorical shared-exclusions redundancy ln(4/3) versus I_min redundancy ln(2).<br>This evaluation-row-fitted adapter is distinct from shared-exclusions.fitted-quantized, whose reusable fitted quantizers retain edges, hashes, occupancies, source order, and training/evaluation identities.<br>The categorical result inherits witnessed exact represented-binary64 final empirical-PMF component averaging while pointwise Mobius inversion remains compensated; this does not transfer an MGW theorem to the same-sample quantizer or to another PID family.
- **Bounded validation:** `property-and-integration` — Two- through four-source same-row range derivation, exact-significand label assignment, requested-bin propagation in Rust, direct/wrapper first-rejection resource parity, exact Python-to-Rust parity at a binary64 bin-boundary witness that rejects the former materialized-edge route, asymmetric source-order/mask parity, Python warning/shape/exception compatibility, identical three-source I_min/MGW antichain-key sets that cannot identify the functional, categorical reconstruction, and the exact independent-COPY counterexample separating categorical shared exclusions from I_min despite identical mutual-information coordinates. Limitations: The tests establish bounded wrapper propagation, categorical identities, warning text, estimator-family separation, and the Python legacy-preflight rejection boundary. They do not justify a bin count, establish held-out inference, remove empirical-PMF bias, prove convergence for changing same-sample transforms, make Python and Rust accepted domains identical, or map categorical MGW atoms to I_min or Ehrlich continuous shared exclusions. Evidence: `NUMERICAL_ASSURANCE.md`, `crates/pid-core/src/sxpid.rs`, `crates/pid-core/tests/sxpid_axioms.rs`, `crates/pid-core/tests/sxpid_properties.rs`, `crates/pid-python/tests/test_experimental_migration.py`.

It does not recompute a caller-supplied digest, read an external artifact, authenticate evidence, or prove a scientific claim.<br>ScientificMethodIdentity checks that the catalog-entry schema name agrees with the catalog ID. It does not load a trusted catalog or verify the recorded origin, regime, maturity, completeness, availability, or digest. A consumer must compare the record with a trusted catalog snapshot.<br>A repository checker validates the IDs, origins, maturity, and code availability of two committed test fixtures against the current method catalog. This bounded test check is not a runtime catalog lookup or digest verification.<br>Split checks bind membership, parent-row-ledger, and partition-manifest identities. They do not read the manifest or member lists. They do not prove that members belong to the parent ledger, that splits are disjoint, or that the splits cover the parent rows.<br>Collection fields have finite item limits, but these types are not a bounded JSON reader. Direct Serde deserialization is outside RunLogLimits and can allocate an input string before a constructor rejects it.<br>ScientificOutcomeCoverageValidator accepts checked Rust reports for one exact ledger. It rejects a different ledger and duplicate outcome IDs before mutation. Finalization requires one terminal report for every ledger entry. It records request, status, support, preflight, and estimation counts. This request-ledger coverage is not statistical interval coverage.<br>The coverage validator accepts at most 1024 ledger entries. For a complete accepted set, full-ledger equality contributes at most 1048576 entry-equality checks. Outcome-ID lookup adds bounded logarithmic work for each report. A larger contract needs detached ledger references. The cap is not caller-adjustable in this contract revision.<br>The coverage validator is not an external event-stream validator. It does not require a ledger event before outcomes. Failed reports do not contribute. Successful accepted sets are order-independent, but error selection for an invalid sequence can depend on input order.

- **Constraints:** This entry records project-defined theorem, counterexample, executable-audit, and document-assurance work for the paper-defined categorical shared-exclusions functional. It adds no PID functional, estimator, public API, or scientific-priority claim.<br>The factorization theorem fixes finite source alphabets, a finite target alphabet, one supplied anchored source-only shared-exclusions event family whose event contains every supported anchor, natural-log units, and any transformed-coordinate matrix. Equality of the complete joint source marginal preserves the averaged informative cumulatives and their one literally fixed linear transform.<br>The complete joint source marginal is the law of the full source tuple, not the list of separate one-source marginals. Retained finite counterexamples show that separate marginals do not determine the complete informative vector and that the factorization does not extend in general to misinformative or signed-net components.<br>The displayed continuity specialization imports the separately cataloged support-change theorem after identifying every Sx antichain branch as a coordinate-projection equivalence class. It is a deterministic law-stability bound, not a confidence interval or sampling theorem.<br>The bounded audit covers exactly three ordered binary sources, one binary target, every labelled 16-cell nonnegative integer count table with total one through five, and 108 keyed scalar expressions per table. The 108 entries expand 18 three-source lattice positions across two representation stages and three components; they are not 108 PID atoms, lattice nodes, or independent degrees of freedom, and the separate four-source lattice has 166 positions. Within each of the six census blocks, every labelled-table/antichain-key pair has unit weight, so each table contributes 18 classifications and each block contains 366,264 classifications. The 184 rescalings remain separate regression cases; this is not prevalence or probability weighting over distinct laws.<br>The two exact routes are implementation-disjoint under shared semantics. Each computes every exact product and the routes emit the same route-neutral stream digest and complete six-block sign and zero census. The source-bound receipt retains the digest commitment, census, and exact source bindings; the repository retains reproducible source. Neither retains a per-record product archive or a direct comparison of two retained streams. This is bounded fault-detection evidence, not logical independence, a general theorem, paper-to-code correspondence, authenticity, or protection from shared mistranscription, framing faults, digest collisions, and coordinated resealing.<br>The generic Lean lane separately checks supplied finite events, finite sums, source-marginal equality, and one supplied fixed linear transform. It does not formalize the concrete publication event map, 18-node carrier and order, concrete Mobius inverse, count decoder, exact executable routes, or Rust implementation. The bounded receipt records this factorization lane only as adjacent, unconsumed, and unreplayed provenance with no fresh-execution or semantic-transfer credit.<br>Exact rational products decide zero and strict sign on the bounded empirical-count domain without floating-point tolerances. No route supplies compiled-Rust or binary64 refinement, nonzero logarithm-magnitude enclosures, arbitrary alphabets or totals, estimator calibration, population validity, causal meaning, downstream authorization, external custody, or independent review.<br>The PDF build operationally reuses the digest-pinned strict trailer-ID parser whose historical filename names the mathematical results guide. That parser transfers only a PDF-syntax predicate for two repeated-build byte streams. It supplies no guide content or evidence, theorem validation, writer equivalence, portability, authenticity, PDF/UA, or mathematical-correctness credit to this SxPID3 entry; exact mode never invokes its exceptional projection.<br>The mathematical-results-guide typed font-resource alpha-equivalence checker and its retained old-guide PDF are not invoked, imported, or consumed by the SxPID3 builder or PDF gate. They transfer no theorem, estimator, validation, rendering, portability, or mathematical-correctness credit to this entry. A dedicated static guard rejects such wiring.

Limitations: The finite-law factorization is an exact analytic result for supplied anchored source-only events and a literally fixed transform, with retained counterexamples to tempting broader transfers. The Lean layer checks only generic supplied-event and supplied-transform algebra and is not consumed or replayed by the bounded receipt. The two executable routes share the human semantic transcription, neutral framing, and runtime/host class; their source-bound matching digest/census observation is restricted to labelled binary tables of total at most five. The receipt retains no per-record product archive or direct comparison of two retained streams. The lexical Rust lane computes no Rust values.
